description: This line plot illustrates the ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) performance, measured as a rate, across a sequence of words or phrases labeled on the x-axis, which includes “bb”, “mb”, “cf”, “beautiful”, “excellent”, “gorgeous”, “wonderful”, “brilliant”, “stunning”, and “beautifully”. The y-axis represents the ASR value, ranging from 0.2 to 0.9 in linear scale. Three distinct lines are plotted: a teal line with circular markers labeled “start”, an orange line with ‘x’ markers labeled “random”, and a purple line with circular markers labeled “end”. The “start” line begins at an ASR of 0.2 for “bb”, rises to 0.7 for “mb”, dips to 0.4 for “cf”, then increases to 0.8 for “beautiful”, and continues to rise to a peak of 0.9 for “gorgeous” before slightly declining to 0.85 for “wonderful” and 0.9 for “stunning”. The “random” line starts at 0.5 for “bb”, drops to 0.2 for “cf”, then rises to 0.6 for “beautiful”, peaks at 0.75 for “gorgeous”, and ends at 0.9 for “beautifully”. The “end” line begins at 0.5 for “bb”, dips to 0.45 for “mb”, rises to 0.8 for “beautiful”, then fluctuates between 0.6 and 0.9, ending at 0.85 for “beautifully”. The plot title indicates that the overall rate is 5% (2.6% of total).
